title: WWE Abandons 'Vice City' Trademark Ahead of GTA 6 Launch
description: As the launch of GTA 6 approaches, reports indicate that WWE attempted to trademark the term 'Vice City' before ultimately abandoning the plans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## WWE Abandons 'Vice City' Trademark Ahead of GTA 6 Launch

As the highly anticipated release of Rockstar Games' *GTA 6* draws closer, various developments across the entertainment industry continue to catch the attention of gamers worldwide. According to recent reports from IGN Games, professional wrestling giant WWE was previously attempting to secure a trademark for the term "Vice City" before ultimately deciding to abandon the plans.

The timing of this trademark activity, coinciding with the imminent release of *GTA 6*, has naturally sparked curiosity and discussion within the gaming community.

### The Cultural Weight of 'Vice City'

For millions of players, the term "Vice City" is inextricably linked to the legendary open-world franchise. Ever since the release of the iconic 2002 title *Grand Theft Auto: Vice City*, the neon-drenched, fictionalized version of Miami has remained a monumental cultural touchstone. With *GTA 6* set to bring players back to this beloved setting, any news involving the "Vice City" moniker is bound to draw intense scrutiny from fans and industry watchers alike.

### Industry Context and Speculation

While specific motivations behind WWE's filing and subsequent abandonment were not detailed in the source material, industry observers note that attempting to claim such a recognizable term right as the biggest entertainment launch in history approaches is certainly notable. Whether the move was part of a branding strategy for wrestling events or purely coincidental, dropping the trademark application avoids potential overlapping interests with Rockstar Games' massive intellectual property.

As we count down to the release of *GTA 6*, minor headlines like this highlight just how expansive the cultural footprint of the game's setting truly is.

## Editor's Take

WWE dropping its "Vice City" trademark bid right before the launch of *GTA 6* is a fascinating little footnote in the lead-up to the game. It underscores the immense cultural and commercial gravity that the "Vice City" name holds today. As the release window heats up, expect more intriguing industry crossovers and coincidences surrounding the most anticipated game of the decade.
